kind: bounded numerical reduction CPU/wall/allocation diagnostic; material regressions explicitly retained
methodology: Identical release source and dependency locks. Allocator-disabled ABBA twice: four fresh processes/version, one warmup and five samples/case. Separate allocator-enabled builds. Process CPU measured using CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID via checked benchmark-only libc clock_gettime; it aggregates process threads and includes timestamp overhead. CLOCK resolution and system scheduling make small-case differences diagnostic, not acceptance thresholds. Public raw calls include validation; validated wrappers are prepared outside timing. Field sign/range certificates, adaptive accumulation, membership construction and temporary scratch remain timed. Construction, schema/conditioned numeric checks and destruction excluded. Checks use tolerance 1e-12 on conditioned bounded inputs and are not precision acceptance tests; independent Python Fraction fixtures supply the strict gate. Grids have 8/16/24 cubed points, hexahedral cells and scalar/vector point fields; decimation uses two-unit cubes. Statistics additionally use 48 cubed point clouds. Modes: positive quantized, spatially separated signs, mixed quantized and deterministic mixed signs with full 53-bit fractions. Baseline loses adversarial residuals and may differ by rounding on mixed data. No claimed speedup from that comparison: regressions are correctness costs requiring further work. Shared host without controlled affinity/thermal conditions. CPU time is not energy, peak/live/RSS memory or mobile/device qualification; allocation bytes are cumulative.
